name: ceramics-webapp

dependencies.description: Backend API for the catalog, cart, checkout, and order/product management.
dependencies.name: ceramics-api

dependencies.description: Thunder-backed OIDC sign-in for shoppers (optional) and the Store Admin (required for the admin area).
dependencies.name: user-auth

description: React SPA serving both the public storefront (catalog browse/search, product detail, cart, guest or signed-in checkout, order history) and the Store Admin area (listing management, order queue and fulfillment) behind role-gated routes. Talks only to ceramics-api; holds no secrets and performs no payment processing itself — checkout collects card details through the payment provider's hosted/embedded element.
